scenarios.name: reviewer_absence
scenarios.story: The busiest reviewer (40% of reviews) stops; the other three absorb it slowly.

scenarios.name: larger_changes
scenarios.story: Pull requests become five times larger and take longer to pick up.

scenarios.name: demand_spike
scenarios.story: Twice as many pull requests arrive for the same three reviewers.

scenarios.name: stable
scenarios.story: Nothing changes: the same team, volume and pace in both windows.

scenarios.name: tiny_sample
scenarios.story: Four pull requests per window: a big-looking change that the data cannot support.
